data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding of $682.0m at 1 January 2017. During 2017 management released prior year reserves totalling $39.7m, driven primarily by favourable prior year claims development across multiple divisions (notably specialty lines and reinsurance). The report highlights prior-year reserve releases deriving largely from older years such as 2010, 2013, 2014 and 2015. Despite significant 2017 natural catastrophe activity (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexican earthquakes and Californian wildfires) that increased net claims in 2017, prior year reserves overall experienced a net release.

The margin held above the actuarial estimate was 5% at the end of 2017 (2016: 6.6%). This margin decreased in 2017 which was in part due to the catastrophe activity in the second half of the year, which resulted in much lower margins than usual in the affected areas.
